description: Allegheny County Traffic Counts (archived) is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County. Traffic sensors at over 1,200 locations in Allegheny County collect vehicle counts for the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation. Data included in the Health Department's DASH project includes hourly averages and average daily counts. The data was collected from years 2012-2014 and compiled by Carnegie Mellon University’s Traffic21 Institute. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County. Its tags are ACHD DASH, Traffic, Traffic count, sensors, social determinants of health. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2025-12-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
